data.name: Sachivat
data.gender_notes: Sachivat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit words 'saha' (with) and 'chivam' (courage). Represents a wise and loyal companion. The name Sachivat carries the meaning “Wise and loyal companion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sachivat usually hope their child will grow to embody wise and loyal companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sachivat belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise and loyal companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sachivat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Sachivat is mentioned as a sage in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. He is a counselor and advisor to King Yudhishthira.
historical_references.context: Mahabharata is a Sanskrit epic containing 100,000 verses, composed between 400 and 200 BCE.

historical_references.reference: Sachivat is also mentioned in the Puranas, a set of sacred texts in Hinduism. He is considered one of the seven wise men of ancient India and is revered for his wisdom and knowledge.
historical_references.context: The Puranas are a collection of 18 major and 18 minor texts, which describe the history of the universe from its creation to destruction.
